notes.title: DAVY x JONES | EARLY ACCESS | PATCH 3
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Ahoy, Landlubbers![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Your feedback from The Locker have been heard! We've been listening to all your words about the game's first minutes, and we're happy to announce that [b]PATCH 3[/b] is now live! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/9150cf2955c08e43244df69690ebab9f6a58fe10.png"][/img]We've gone back to the drawing board and redesigned the beginning of the game, making your descent into hell even more epic. [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]A Fresh Start: The Redesigned Beginning[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We've completely overhauled the early game experience to make sure your first steps into The Locker are as impactful and brutal as they were meant to be. This isn't just a quick change- [b]we've restructured the tutorial and the initial quests to provide a smoother learning curve while still throwing you straight into the thick of the action.[/b] Your journey of revenge now starts with a bang, ensuring you feel the weight of your betrayal and the power of your fury from the get-go.

[/p][h3][b]More Fixes Than You Can Shake a Headless Body At[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This patch isn't just about the beginning. We've also rolled out a ton of fixes and improvements under the hood based on your reports. For example - We have a new languages added - [b]POLISH , and JAPANESE[/b].   You can expect general performance and stability optimizations, quality-of-life tweaks, and various bug fixes across all the islands. We're constantly working to polish every nook and cranny of this cursed world to give you the best experience possible.  The full list is below: [/p][h3]
[b]PATCH 3 NOTES:[/b] 
[/h3][h3] Key Updates [/h3][list][*][p] Early game redesigned [/p][/*][*][p] Added POLISH and JAPANESE localization [/p][/*][*][p] Stability and performance optimizations 
[/p][/*][/list][h3] Gameplay [/h3][list][*][p] Adjustments to attacks and skills for smoother combat [/p][/*][*][p] Skills cost adjustments [/p][/*][*][p] Gamepad input tweaks [/p][/*][*][p] Tempest indicator now only active during combat [/p][/*][*][p] Cannon trap base deactivation conditions added [/p][/*][*][p] Davy behavior improvements (positioning and puppet events) [/p][/*][*][p] Treasury encounter adjusted (enemy types changed) [/p][/*][*][p] Item purchase now possible with hold button [/p][/*][*][p] Improved clarity of tutorial pop-up messages 
[/p][/*][/list][h3] UI & Settings & Widgets [/h3][list][*][p] Added UI scaling option [/p][/*][*][p] Tutorial videos potential fix for playback issues [/p][/*][*][p] Widgets improved for clarity and scaled up (prompts, Skill Tree, inventory, quest log, map, others) [/p][/*][*][p] Loading widget and quest log improvements [/p][/*][*][p] Icon fixes across UI elements 
[/p][/*][/list][h3] Audio & Visuals [/h3][list][*][p] Prologue and weapon acquisition cutscene audio tweaks [/p][/*][*][p] Sword rapid attack SFX redesigned [/p][/*][*][p] Skipping cutscenes now properly adjusts audio mix [/p][/*][*][p] Soundscapes no longer stop when changing levels [/p][/*][*][p] Proper stopping of audio and mix when transitioning between levels 

  [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]A massive thanks to all of you who have been with us on this journey. Your feedback is what makes this game stronger with every update. Jump back in, experience the new beginning, and let us know what you think![/b][/p][p]
Think you've got a killer idea for an execution? Found a bug that’s more twisted than a Kraken's tentacles? Or maybe you just want to shout about that epic moment where you sent some fiends packing? [b]We're all ears, you mad lads and lasses![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/af7d22484caf9bf8384674bf5a7b097621a071d2.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b][/p][p align="start"][url="https://discord.gg/gbG4sGCnQ6" style="button"]Join our Discord! [/url][b]
[/b][/p][p align="start"]Don't just stand there, rotting in The Locker! Our [b]Discord [/b]is the ultimate pirate hangout, where we're constantly lurking, listening, and ready to lend a hand. We're reading your thoughts, watching your clips, and we're even taking notes on your ideas. Found a bug that's driving you nuts? [b]We're on it.[/b] Need a little help on your quest for revenge? [b]We're here for you.[/b]

Until next Time,
PARASIGHT TEAM[/p]

notes.title: DAVY x JONES | EARLY ACCESS | PATCH 2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Ahoy, Landlubbers! [/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Your voices from the depths of The Locker have been heard![/b] We've been hard at work for the past couple of days, listening to all your feedback and investigating the issues, and now we're pumped to drop our latest chest full of fixes and improvements for the game with [b]PATCH 2[/b] - This one's all about polishing up the core experience of the game, smoothing out the quest flow, and making your path to revenge even more satisfying and hopefully - without any new issues.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]So boot up and get ready to return.[/b] The Locker awaits...
[/h3][hr][/hr][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/7d210f5b57fbf1150b9df6965495a347e75e53b7.png"][/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b] [/h2][h2]
[/h2][h3][b]Skill Tree & Combat
[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Skill Tree polished with proper names, improved audio, and usability tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Parry system updated for smoother animations and feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]General balance and animation improvements to combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quests & Critical Path[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]"Cannon Fodder" quest major improvements to clarity and difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Path adjusted for smoother progression.[/p][/*][*][p]"Hook to the moon" quest step clarity increased.[/p][/*][*][p]"Escape Arrrtists" quest multiple fixes to dialogues and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]"To Lure Them All" quests Kegs boss final stage hard lock fix.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]World & Exploration[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Skullkeep, Crossbones, and Limbo: multiple fixes to traps, spawners, dialogues, and collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Kurak visibility improved during Limbo port quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Gunner visibility improved during Skullkeep quest and on Abby's deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Soulwell, Soulorbs, and Soulshells improved with new interactions and better functionality.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][h3][b]
[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Optimized metasounds and overall audio mix.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio corrections in Dead Sea, Torrent Cannon, Skullkeep, and Skill Tree.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]General Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Minigame tweaks (Chicken Colosseum, Torrent Cannon).[/p][/*][*][p]Fusions probability increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization and tutorial text fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Stability and performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest markers (X) corrected and improved.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for helping us shaping the future of this revenge story. The journey is far from over of course, but your feedback is also a compass guiding our way.   [b]Jump back in, check out the changes, and let us know what you think![/b]

Remember - We truly value community feedback and are actively listening to what [b]YOU[/b] have to say.
One of the best ways to get your thoughts to us, and to connect with other people playing the game, is by joining our [url="https://discord.gg/gbG4sGCnQ6"]official Discord server[/url]. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/d4506d90d70534e6facb42a18e59148c465d8617.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You'll find a dedicated space there to share your ideas, report bugs, and chat directly with the development team. We believe this open dialogue is key to making the game the best it can be, and we can't wait to see you there!

See you next time, 
[b]PARASIGHT TEAM[/b]

[/p]
